title: Diagnostics
description: Record a slowdown and get evidence-based feedback from Kudu Cloud AI.
localFirst: Reproduce the slowdown while Kudu records. Measurements stay on this device until you review and approve an upload.
requiresPro: New recordings and analysis require an active Cloud Pro subscription.
collectProcesses: Collect top process names and counters locally
sampling: Recording continues when you leave this page. Quitting Kudu interrupts it. Some measurements may be unavailable.
retention: Recordings stay encrypted on this device. Nothing is uploaded automatically. Save up to 30 recordings; export and delete old ones when you need space.
stopToReview: Stop the recording, then reopen it to review, export or share.
name: Name
exportPrivacy: Exports are unencrypted and include collected process names. Choose where you save and share them.
comparisonCaution: Sample averages describe observations, not causality. Repeat the same workload for similar durations; gaps and background activity can change results.
notComparable: System specifications differ. A direct before/after comparison is not available.
comparisonValues: Comparison recording: CPU {{cpu}}, memory {{memory}}. Durations: {{first}}s / {{second}}s. Comparison missing ticks: {{missing}}.
cloudPrivacy: Kudu Cloud sends your measurements to OpenAI for analysis. Raw Cloud input is removed after analysis; abandoned jobs are cleared after 30 minutes at the next maintenance run. Cloud reports expire after seven days. Provider processing is subject to the service privacy policy. A copy of the recording and retrieved report is kept on this device.
shareProcesses: Include collected process names and counters in this upload
consent: This sends the data shown above, together with your linked device ID, to Kudu Cloud and OpenAI to analyze this recording. Local notes, file paths, command lines and account details are excluded from the recording payload.
consentButton: I agree — upload for AI analysis
cloudGone: The Cloud copy was deleted or has expired. Any retrieved report remains available locally.
analysisFailed: No reliable report was produced. Create another recording to try again.
aiCaution: AI suggestions can be wrong. Review the evidence before making changes; Kudu does not execute these suggestions.
evidenceLimit: First 50 samples in this evidence range. A dash means unavailable.
confirmLocal: Delete this local recording and its downloaded report? Any Cloud copy must be deleted first, so nothing remains in Kudu Cloud. Export first if you need a copy.
deleteLocalBlocked: Delete the Cloud copy first. This local recording holds the only reference needed to remove it.
confirmCloud: Delete this recording and report from Kudu Cloud? Your local copy remains. An analysis already sent to the provider cannot be recalled, but its result will not be saved back to Cloud.
emptyHint: Record while the slowdown happens. You can review the measurements before sharing them.
accessUnavailable: Cloud access could not be checked. Check your connection and try again.
upgradeTitle: Find out what is slowing your PC down.
upgradeDescription: Turn a slowdown into a clear next step with Kudu Cloud Pro. Record what happens and get AI feedback grounded in your PC's measurements.
supportDevelopment: Your subscription also supports Kudu's open-source development.
reconnectDescription: Link this PC again to check your Cloud Pro access. Your saved recordings are still here.
accessUnavailableTitle: We couldn't check your Cloud access

capture.title: Capture the slowdown
capture.description: Record CPU, memory and disk activity while the problem happens.

understand.title: Understand the cause
understand.description: Get AI findings tied to the recording, with practical next steps.

control.title: Stay in control
control.description: Review your recording first. Nothing is uploaded without your approval.

flow.description: Capture a slowdown. Let Kudu Cloud find the next step.
flow.recordHint: Start recording, then do whatever makes your PC feel slow. We'll capture the performance data for Cloud AI to analyze.
flow.recordingHint: Open your apps, switch tabs, or repeat the task that feels slow. Finish when you've captured the problem, or let the recording end automatically.
flow.collectHint: Capture top process names and usage. You choose whether to share them in the next step.
flow.uploadControl: You review and approve before anything is uploaded.
flow.signalHint: CPU, memory and disk activity give Cloud AI a picture of the slowdown.
flow.detailsTitle: Give this recording a little context.
flow.detailsHint: Choose a name you'll recognize and jot down what was happening.
flow.namePlaceholder: e.g. Slow startup with browser open
flow.notesPlaceholder: What were you doing? When did it feel slow?
flow.notesHint: For your reference. Names and notes are not sent to the AI.
flow.shareProcesses: Share captured app names and usage with Cloud AI
flow.measurementHint: Cloud AI will look for patterns in these measurements and suggest what to investigate.
flow.tooShort: There isn't enough data to analyze. Start a new recording and let it run for a few seconds before finishing.
flow.readyHint: Your performance measurements and system specifications will be sent to Kudu Cloud and OpenAI for analysis.
flow.consent: By choosing Analyze on Cloud, you approve sending this data with your linked device ID. Notes, file paths and command lines are excluded.
flow.uploadingHint: Sending the measurements you approved to Kudu Cloud.
flow.queuedTitle: Your recording is in the queue.
flow.processingTitle: Cloud AI is analyzing the slowdown…
flow.processingHint: We'll check for the report automatically. You can leave this page and return to this session later.
flow.pendingHint: The upload was not confirmed. Retrieve the report to check, or retry the same upload.
flow.cloudOnly: Analysis is powered by Kudu Cloud Pro.
flow.confirmDelete: Delete this recording and its report, including any Cloud copy? This cannot be undone. An analysis already sent to the provider cannot be recalled.
